body:
MV3 kept OBSERVATIONAL webRequest: onHeadersReceived registered non-blocking with ['responseHeaders','extraHeaders'] still delivers the raw HttpOnly Set-Cookie, tagged with the exact details.tabId.

This is easy to assume died with blocking webRequest. It did not, and it is the read half of per-tab cookie isolation — declarativeNetRequest can SET or REMOVE the cookie header but can never READ one, so without this there is no way to learn a session's cookies without chrome.debugger.

Executed and observed on Chrome 154.0.8037.93 on 2026-10-02 via spike/run-test.mjs: two tabs on one origin held two different logins across a refresh of both, with no debugger attached and no infobar.
